name: @msout/api
description: Public API: session state, pool manager, SSE hub, credential forwarder, CORS/CSRF, rate limits. No Docker socket, no vault mount, no egress.

engines.comment: 22.5 is the floor for node:sqlite, which is the api's database driver. A native addon (better-sqlite3) would mean a compilation step and a prebuilt-binary supply chain in the component that must not have either.
